title: A limiting law for standardized low-temperature SK free energy
exact_target: For Gaussian zero-field SK at every fixed $\beta >1$, does the centered free energy divided by its own standard deviation converge in distribution through all n to a nondegenerate mean-zero variance-one law with a finite exponential moment near zero, uniquely specified by the limiting moment sequence?
